description: Pole-mounted Sabre by the Hanscom main gate at 42.46197 -71.27985. It wears 53-1328; Baugher's 1953 page says the aircraft on the pole at Hanscom painted as 31328 may actually be 53-1353. True identity recorded here with the painted number in aliases.
Three-quarter-scale replica P-40 displayed at 42.46036 -71.27973 near the Hanscom gate. Replica - not an original airframe. No serial; the marking reported by lead lists is 84534.

Aerial Visuals fixes a C-130A at 42.46777 -71.27290 on the Hanscom flight line side with a public vantage point at 42.47219 -71.27594. Baugher's 1955 page carries no disposition line for 55-0019; the serial passes an FY55 C-130A block check. Currency unconfirmed.
